name: Shop consumables usage sheet
notes: The maintenance lead's sheet: areas instead of work-center codes, usage written as '0.6 per 10 run hrs' or '1 per 90 pcs' in two columns, a blank area for site-wide monthly use. Areas map to work centers; 'run hrs', 'pcs' and 'monthly' are read as per machine hour, per unit and per month.
